text: If the zombie apocalypse starts on a cruise ship, and you finally make it to land...
don't jump out yet. Look at the quay.
Rule one. Cut the engine before you reach the shore.
They're asleep on their feet. Keep it that way.
Rule two. Follow the signs only the living would leave.
Zombies don't draw arrows. And they never draw smiley faces.
Rule three. Prove you're still human.
Zombies can't smile. So give them your biggest grin.
The lights are out on purpose. Light brings them in.
Then a horn sounds, out in the fog.
You never switched those engines off.
